headline: 3-0 loss: Bangladesh thumped by Malaysia in ASEAN Cup opener
summary: The national team struggled to create chances as Arif Aiman's brace and a goal from Bergson sealed a disappointing start in Jakarta.
details: Bangladesh suffered a heavy 3-0 defeat against Malaysia in their opening Group A match of the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026.
The match took place at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia, where Thomas Dooley's side struggled to find their rhythm.
Malaysia's winger Arif Aiman dominated the first half, netting two goals to give the hosts a commanding lead.
Forward Bergson added a third goal in the 52nd minute, further cementing the victory for the Malaysian side.
The Bangladeshi squad struggled to create any meaningful scoring opportunities throughout the game.
Bangladesh will look to bounce back in their next fixture against Singapore on September 28 at the same venue.
caption:
A tough start in Jakarta. Bangladesh falls 3-0 to Malaysia in their ASEAN Cup opener.

Bangladesh suffered a heavy 3-0 defeat against Malaysia in their opening Group A match of the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026.

The match took place at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia, where Thomas Dooley's side struggled to find their rhythm.

Malaysia's winger Arif Aiman dominated the first half, netting two goals to give the hosts a commanding lead.

Forward Bergson added a third goal in the 52nd minute, further cementing the victory for the Malaysian side.

The Bangladeshi squad struggled to create any meaningful scoring opportunities throughout the game.

Bangladesh will look to bounce back in their next fixture against Singapore on September 28 at the same venue.

headline: Police constable and wife arrested for cutting off boy's finger in Natore
summary: The couple, who were tenants in the victim's house, allegedly trapped an 8-year-old boy in their room and mutilated him following a trivial children's quarrel.
details: A police constable and his wife have been arrested in Natore for allegedly cutting off the finger of an eight-year-old boy.
The arrestees, Md Shakil, a constable at the Natore police superintendent’s office, and his wife Naorin, were sent to jail following a case filed by the victim's father, Mahamudul Hasan.
The couple had been living as tenants in Mahamudul's house in the Boro Harishpur area of Natore municipality.
According to the case, a dispute arose between the boy and the tenant family's children while playing on Wednesday night, which was initially settled.
However, the couple allegedly trapped the boy in their room the following day and cut off his finger as an act of revenge.
The child was first taken to Natore Adhunik Sadar Hospital and later referred to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
The victim's father has demanded strict punishment for the brutality inflicted on his child over a trivial quarrel.
Natore district police officials stated that they are investigating the case and will take legal action against the constable in accordance with procedure.
caption:
A police constable and his wife allegedly trapped an 8-year-old boy and cut off his finger over a children's quarrel.
